keywords.indexterm: driving electric vehicle LCD display messages

section.title: Low battery
section.p: When the high voltage battery level reaches around 25% (20% for extended type battery) or less, this warning message is displayed.
The warning light on the instrument cluster () will turn on simultaneously. Charge the battery immediately.

section.title: Charge immediately. Power limited
section.p: When the high voltage battery level reaches around 15% (10% for extended type battery) or less, this warning message is displayed.
The warning light on the instrument cluster () will turn on simultaneously.
The vehicle’s power will be reduced to minimize the energy consumption of the high voltage battery. Charge the battery immediately.

section.title: Check electric vehicle system
section.p: This warning message is displayed when there is a problem with the electric vehicle control system.

note.p: Refrain from driving when the warning message is displayed.
If this occurs, park the vehicle in a safe location. Have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Power limited
section.p: In the following cases, this warning message is displayed when the vehicle’s power is limited for safety.

li.p: When the power is limited for the safety of the high-powered parts of an electric vehicle. The power is limited for the following reasons. (Unless both Service Warning Light and Power Down Indicator Light illuminate at the same time, it is not a failure.)
The high voltage battery level is too low or voltage is decreasing.
The temperature of the high voltage battery is too high or too low.
The temperature of the motor is high.

note.p: When this warning message is displayed, do not accelerate or start the vehicle suddenly. Charge the battery immediately when the high voltage battery level is not enough.

When the power is limited for the safety of the high-powered parts of an electric vehicle, the power down indicator light illuminates. Your vehicle may not be driven, or may roll back on a slope with the indicator light ON.

section.title: Power limited due to low EV battery temperature. Charge battery

entry.p: (A) Power limited due to low EV battery temperature. Charge battery

section.p: The warning message is displayed to protect the electric vehicle system when you turn off or turn on the vehicle while outside temperature is low. If the high voltage battery charging level is low and parked outside in low temperature for a long time, vehicle power could be limited. Charging the battery before driving, increases the battery temperature, and helps increase power.

note.p: If this warning message is still displayed even when the ambient temperature is sufficiently high, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Battery overheated! Stop safely
section.p: This warning message is displayed to protect battery and electric vehicle system when the high voltage battery temperature is too high.
Turn off the EV button and stop the vehicle so that the battery temperature decreases.

note.p: If this warning is still displayed even after the POWER button has been turned off for sufficient time, refrain from driving and have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Stop safely and check power supply

entry.p: (A) Stop safely and check power supply

section.p: This warning message is displayed when a failure occurs in the 12 V power supply system.
If this occurs, park the vehicle in a safe location. Have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Unplug vehicle to start
section.p: This message is displayed when you start the vehicle, without unplugging the charging cable, and will not shift out of park. Unplug the charging cable, and then turn on the vehicle.

section.title: Charging door open
section.p: This message is displayed when the vehicle is driven with the charging door opened. Close the charging door and then start driving.

section.title: Remaining time
section.p: The remaining charging time in the LCD image may differ from actual charging time.
This message is displayed to notify the remaining time to charge the battery, to the selected target battery charge level, and the charge voltage level.

section.title: Charging interrupted. Please check the AC charger/Charging interrupted. Please check the DC charger

entry.p: (A) Charging interrupted. Please check the AC charger
(A) Charging interrupted. Please check the DC charger

section.p: This warning message is displayed when charging is stopped for the reasons below:

li.p: There is a problem with the external AC charger or DC charger.
The external AC charger stopped charging

section.p: If this occurs, check whether there is any problem with the external AC or DC charger and charging cable.

If the same problem occurs when charging the vehicle with a well-functioning external charger or genuine Kia portable charger, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Charging interrupted. Please check the cable connection

entry.p: (A) Charging interrupted. Please check the cable connection

section.p: This warning message is displayed for the reasons below:

li.p: The charging connector is not correctly connected to the charging inlet.
The charging connector lock release button is pressed.

section.p: If this occurs, separate the charging connector and connect it again.
Check whether there is any problem (external damage, foreign substances, etc.) with the charging connector and charging inlet.

If the same problem occurs when charging the vehicle with a replaced charging cable or genuine Kia portable charger, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Check virtual engine sound system
section.p: This message is displayed when there is a problem with the Virtual Engine Sound System (VESS).
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Check Active Air Flap system
section.p: This warning message is displayed in the following situations:

li.p: There is a malfunction with the actuator flap
There is a malfunction with the actuator air flap controller
The air flap does not open

section.p: When all the above conditions are fixed, the warning will disappear.

section.title: Refill coolant
section.p: This message is displayed when the coolant is low. If the warning message is displayed, stop driving and have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner. Driving under coolant for a prolonged period of time can cause serious problems with the vehicle’s electrical equipment and make normal driving impossible.
